name: Elsterrier Marigold
original_name: エルステリア・マリーゴールド
source:
Elsterrier is the younger twin sister of her highly esteemed and current Beltina of the Snow Festival, [url=/c1559]Caroline[/url]. Despite her own wish to be a Beltina, she isn’t as perturbed to remain under Caroline’s shadow. But Caroline’s larger bust size is a significant concern. Els is the more "grounded" of the two and takes care of her older sister in practical matters like doing house chores and grocery shopping. El’s Beltina dance is flawless in technique but does not have "feeling" in it. She is also [url=/c10696]Kazuki's[/url] classmate with excellent grades.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=4098&cpage=1#comment-107931]m3rryweather's review[/url]]
